motivation: The arXiv 2605.10142 4.1pp SWE-Bench uplift plus 31.4 percent router-compute cut pairs naturally with the v0.11.5-rc1 expert-fused-router pass.

motivation_fil: Ang 4.1pp SWE-Bench uplift at 31.4 porsyentong bawas sa router-compute ng arXiv 2605.10142 ay natural na kumakapit sa expert-fused-router pass ng v0.11.5-rc1.

job: Shepherding the Reservoir Routing reference implementation, reproduction harness, and integration patches into upstream vLLM and SGLang.
job_ja: Reservoir Routingのリファレンス実装、再現ハーネス、統合パッチを、vLLMおよびSGLangの上流に導く作業。
job_es: Guiar la implementación de referencia de Reservoir Routing, el arnés de reproducción y los parches de integración hacia el upstream de vLLM y SGLang.
job_fil: Pinapatnubayan ang reference implementation, reproduction harness, at integration patches ng Reservoir Routing patungo sa upstream ng vLLM at SGLang.
outcome: A maintained reference repo, reproducible benchmarks within 2.5 percent, and merged PRs landing the primitive in both serving stacks.
outcome_ja: メンテナンスされたリファレンスリポジトリ、2.5%以内で再現可能なベンチマーク、両サービングスタックにプリミティブを実装するマージ済みPR。
outcome_es: Un repo de referencia mantenido, benchmarks reproducibles dentro del 2.5 por ciento, y PRs fusionados que aterrizan el primitivo en ambos stacks.
outcome_fil: Isang maintained na reference repo, reproducible na benchmarks sa loob ng 2.5 porsyento, at mga merged PR na nag-aabot ng primitive sa parehong serving stacks.
motivation: Citations and adoption velocity for the primitive depend on it landing inside the dominant open-source serving stacks within the same release cycle.
motivation_ja: プリミティブの引用数と採用速度は、同一リリースサイクル内に主流のオープンソースサービングスタックに実装されるかどうかに依存する。
motivation_es: Las citas y la velocidad de adopción del primitivo dependen de que aterrice en los stacks de serving open-source dominantes dentro del mismo ciclo de release.
motivation_fil: Ang citations at adoption velocity ng primitive ay depende sa pag-land nito sa nangungunang open-source serving stacks sa loob ng parehong release cycle.

job: Designing the customer-facing router-state-bank capacity slider as a configuration option on the hosted MoE inference tier.
job_ja: ホスト型MoE推論ティアにおける顧客向けrouter-state-bank容量スライダーを構成オプションとして設計する作業。
job_es: Diseñar el deslizador de capacidad router-state-bank de cara al cliente como opción de configuración en el tier de inferencia MoE gestionada.
job_fil: Dinidisenyo ang customer-facing router-state-bank capacity slider bilang configuration option sa hosted MoE inference tier.
outcome: At least one hosted-inference tier (Together, Fireworks, Anyscale, or a Big-3 hyperscaler) exposes reservoir routing behind a configurable slider.
outcome_ja: 少なくとも1つのホスト型推論ティア(Together、Fireworks、Anyscale、または3大ハイパースケーラーのいずれか)が、reservoir routingを設定可能なスライダーの背後に公開する。
outcome_es: Al menos un tier de inferencia gestionada (Together, Fireworks, Anyscale o un Big-3) expone reservoir routing detrás de un deslizador configurable.
outcome_fil: Hindi bababa sa isang hosted-inference tier (Together, Fireworks, Anyscale, o Big-3 hyperscaler) ang naglalabas ng reservoir routing sa likod ng configurable slider.
motivation: Agentic-workload tenants demand multi-turn tool-use throughput; surfacing the knob is a near-zero-cost SKU differentiator on top of the upstream patch.
motivation_ja: エージェント型ワークロードのテナントが多ターンツール使用スループットを求めており、ノブの公開は上流パッチに乗せる近ゼロコストのSKU差別化要因となる。
motivation_es: Los inquilinos de cargas agénticas exigen throughput de tool-use multivuelta; exponer el knob es un diferenciador SKU de costo casi cero sobre el parche upstream.
motivation_fil: Hinihingi ng mga agentic-workload tenant ang multi-turn tool-use throughput; ang paglalantad ng knob ay halos-zero-cost na SKU differentiator sa ibabaw ng upstream patch.

job: Pushing hosted-inference vendors to surface reservoir routing to cut per-turn router cost on long tool-use chains exceeding eight calls.
job_ja: 8回超のツール使用チェーンでターンあたりのルーター費用を削減するため、ホスト型推論ベンダーにreservoir routingの公開を要求する作業。
job_es: Presionar a los proveedores de inferencia gestionada para exponer reservoir routing y recortar el coste de router por turno en cadenas de tool-use de más de ocho llamadas.
job_fil: Pinipilit ang hosted-inference vendors na ilantad ang reservoir routing upang bawasan ang per-turn router cost sa long tool-use chains na higit sa walong calls.
outcome: Procurement and reference-deployment commitments that give serving vendors a demand-side reason to ship the knob on managed tiers.
outcome_ja: サービングベンダーがマネージドティアでノブを出荷する需要面の理由を与える、調達およびリファレンスデプロイのコミットメント。
outcome_es: Compromisos de procurement y despliegues de referencia que dan a los vendors de serving una razón de demanda para enviar el knob en tiers gestionados.
outcome_fil: Mga procurement at reference-deployment commitments na nagbibigay sa serving vendors ng demand-side dahilan para mag-ship ng knob sa managed tiers.
motivation: The 31.4 percent router-compute cut and 4.1pp SWE-Bench uplift translate directly into agentic-workload unit-economics for tool-use-heavy tenants.
motivation_ja: 31.4%のルーター計算削減と4.1ポイントのSWE-Bench向上が、ツール使用主体のテナントにとってエージェント型ワークロードの単位経済性に直結するため。
motivation_es: El recorte del 31.4 por ciento en cómputo de router y el aumento de 4.1pp en SWE-Bench se traducen en unit-economics de cargas agénticas para inquilinos intensivos en tool-use.
motivation_fil: Ang 31.4 porsyentong router-compute cut at 4.1pp SWE-Bench uplift ay direktang nag-translate sa agentic-workload unit-economics para sa tool-use-heavy tenants.
